source: Original publisher 2021 Student Task Statements PDFs, retrieved independently on authorized Our-CS and inspected as page-structured PDF content. All 20 local PDF bytes were SHA-256 hashed.
rights: For comparison only. No source PDF, publisher image, worksheet or verbatim source body is checked into Edulytics. Descriptions are independent paraphrases.
important: Reading the original student task TEXT does not certify graphics, centre participation, learner-produced drawings/writing, live school UAT or academic acceptance.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Number-talk opening and classroom counting; the printed student sheet has a reflective warm-up, while counting collections and number race are teacher-run activities.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Live learner counting collection activity and actual number-race centre participation unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Match pictured dot groups to expressions and totals, draw missing dots, and author a matching addition expression.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student-drawn missing dots and student-authored expression response unverified for all source sub-tasks.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Interpret dot-cube images, practise adding one or two, and choose from several addition/subtraction centres.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Actual Five in a Row game/centre choice participation unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Mentally add one or two in a warm-up, subtract one or two, and take part in a choice centre.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Subtract-one/two centre play and choice workflow unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Work mixed addition/subtraction, choose centre activities, and recap counting on/back.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Choice-centre interactions and required mixed arithmetic portfolio unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Inspect representations of math tools; choose from number race, five-in-a-row, pair-making, and other centres.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student-choice flow across the five source-centre options unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Notice math tools, sort them into groups, and choose one of the arithmetic centres.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Teacher-observed free sorting and centre selection parity unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Sort shape cards, display categories so another student understands, and independently count all categories.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student-generated shape display and category explanation workflow only partially browser-covered.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Choose a real class-survey question with up to three options, collect physical cube votes, and represent class data.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Actual participants, votes and physical-cube survey collection cannot be certified by simulated test data.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Choose between the addition/subtraction and pair-making centre activities.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student can access arithmetic Practice, but original centre-choice participation unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Evaluate true/false statements about an illustrated pet-survey tally chart; write three separate observations, then choose a centre.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student-authored three true observations not proved by numeric-only source-aligned Practice.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Read tally-mark and numeric category tables, count categories individually, combine two groups, and find the survey total.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Tally and number-table forms with independently counted category totals not both verified in student UI.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Determine whether given questions are answerable from an illustrated graph; author answerable questions and investigate home-survey data.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Student-authored questions are not proved by a correct answerable-question selection alone.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Practise counting plus/minus two and select an arithmetic/sort-display centre.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Choice-centre participation and original centre mix not fully verified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Choose a survey question, collect ten participant responses, author questions about the collected data, and create a poster.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Exactly ten real votes, genuine custom questions and poster/share work not verified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Use library joining/leaving narratives, model the changes with a drawing or objects, solve and write matching expressions.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Multiple student-authored expressions and drawing/word explanation not proved by binary operation-choice questions.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Write full equations for join/leave book and library stories, also showing independently how an answer was obtained.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Full equation authoring and learner drawing/word reasoning not proved by 1-or-2 matching questions.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Find an unknown number of books added, evaluate another child's pictured equation and reasoning, and select a centre.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Reasoning about the pictured peer equation, authored drawing, and alternate-centre choice unverified.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Compare result-unknown with change-unknown book stories, solve take-from examples, and write an equation plus representation for each.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Original page drawing/equation submissions not proved by a numeric total or change answer.

lessons.paraphrasedStudentTaskCoverage: Use an illustrated math warm-up, choose Sort and Display / Math Stories / Find the Pair, and construct/tell a story from a picture.
lessons.academicOrInteractionEvidenceStillRequir: Authored student math picture/story and genuine three-centre choice not proved by a labeled diagram plus multiple choice.
